newsitem.title: USA: US Plains fed cattle trade at $66.00 - feedlots.
newsitem.headline: US Plains fed cattle trade at $66.00 - feedlots.

text.p: U.S. Plains feedlot cattle trading turned moderate to active late Tuesday morning at $66.00 per cwt, feedlots sources said.
Industry sources said about 14,000 head sold in the Texas Panhandle and about 12,000 in Kansas, with the top at $66.00 per cwt.
"It's an active trade," said a Texas feedlot manager, who said he sold steers weighing 1,100 lbs and heifers weighing 1,050 at $66.00.
At $66.00, feedlot sources said they would earn a small profit because of good rates and cost of gains.
No special conditions were reported on Tuesday's sales, with the cattle expected to be delivered with the normal seven days.

Cattle performance has been excellent in the Plains because of mild autumn weather. Near 80-degree temperatures were forecast for Tuesday in the Texas Panhandle, and that area so far has largely been missed by cold and snow. Feedlot managers reported excellent rates of gains, some up to 3.5 lbs per day, others near 3.2.
